title: Litematica Easy Place Indicator
description: This mod adds a very simple on screen indicator when you have your easy place mode on in Litematica!
body:
This mod is a very simple on screen indicator for when you have your easy place mod on in Litematica!

**How to use:**
- Add the mod to your client along with Litematica & Malilib
- Turn on easy place mode
- Look in the top left!
